src/types/annotations.ts.description: Annotation type system uses discriminated unions with 'type' field as discriminator. Four annotation types: text (position + text), arrow (startPoint + endPoint), zone (shape + center + size), drawing (points array). Includes serialization for JSON persistence with Date to ISO string conversion.

src/components/Annotations/TextAnnotatio.description: TextAnnotation component uses @react-three/drei Text wrapped in Billboard for camera-facing readability. Text positioned at annotation.points[0] with height offset of 0.5 above field. Uses black outline for visibility on green field background.

src/components/Annotations/ArrowAnnotati.description: ArrowAnnotation component renders directional arrows using line segment with cone arrowhead. Uses bufferGeometry for line, coneGeometry for arrowhead. Cone rotation calculated via spherical coordinates (phi=acos(direction.y), theta=atan2(direction.x, direction.z)) with 'YXZ' Euler order. Cone positioned with -coneHeight/2 offset so tip is exactly at endpoint.
